# Comprehensive Requirements Quality Gate: Soil Health Visualization

**Purpose**: Exhaustive requirements-quality validation across rendering, concurrency, accessibility, and configuration domains
**Created**: 2026-09-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md) | [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Depth**: Comprehensive — covers all quality dimensions including low-impact edge cases
**Audience**: Both author (self-check) and reviewer (PR gate)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for unknown/unavailable data rendering (neutral gray #808080)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK007 Are tooltip rendering requirements specified including format, positioning, and timing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-015, SC-004]
- [x] CHK008 Are hoe feedback rendering requirements specified for both flash (300ms) and floating text (1000ms)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §Clarifications]

- [x] CHK010 Is the accessibility pattern rendering specified (stripes, dots, solid) with minimum opacity 0.7? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
